claims.claim: The frame-playback ep26 policy trained on ml40 passes the Day 1 criteria: ADD-AUC 0.492 against a do-nothing baseline of 0.4406, and chord_sr and maniptrans_sr both 0.9561.
The frame-playback ep27 policy trained on mf4090 with a 4M buffer passes the Day 1 criteria, with ADD-AUC 0.6487 against a baseline of 0.2721 and maniptrans_sr 0.3208.
In the ml40 Day 2 table, the frame-playback ep13 and ep10 policies fail the Day 1 criteria, and both have maniptrans_sr 0.
In the ml40 Day 2b table, the ep10, ep4 and ep2 policies all fail the Day 1 criteria, and all three have maniptrans_sr 0.
In the mf4090 night1 table, the ep21 and ep3 policies fail the Day 1 criteria, and both have maniptrans_sr 0.
None of the six runs in the ml40 Day 2b table and the mf4090 night1 table was marked invalid.
The registered Day 2 comparison reaches no Q1 conclusion because only one valid non-floor voting sequence remains.
Under the registered Q3 rule, a 4M buffer on mf4090 is not usable for real-time playback because neither seed reaches the bar, and the measured seed-to-seed difference in gap is about -0.010.
The frame-playback ep4 policy has chord_sr 0.
The frame-playback ep3 policy passes the Day 1 criteria.
